claimProvenance.claim: StakDock is an independent directory operated by its founder using automated research and primary source verification without pay-to-play review manipulation.
claimProvenance.notes: Official company disclosure and operational charter.

claimProvenance.claim: Evaluations follow a 5-step objective framework prioritizing primary sources, normalized pricing, and factual technical specs.
claimProvenance.notes: Public evaluation protocol and error submission guidelines.

claimProvenance.claim: Cursor Pro is $20/mo offering 500 fast requests with Claude 3.5/3.7 Sonnet, multi-file Composer, and VS Code extension compatibility.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against live Cursor pricing and release changelog.

claimProvenance.claim: GitHub Copilot Individual is $10/mo ($100/yr) and Business is $19/user/mo supporting VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio, and Neovim.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against GitHub official plans documentation.

claimProvenance.claim: Make Core plan is $9/mo for 10,000 operations with visual workflow routing and 1-minute execution intervals.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against Make (Celonis) pricing page.

claimProvenance.claim: n8n community edition is 100% free for self-hosting with unlimited executions under Sustainable Use License; cloud starts at €20/mo.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against n8n GitHub repository and pricing portal.

claimProvenance.claim: Moz Pro Standard plan is $99/mo including 300 tracked keywords with weekly updates and Domain Authority metrics.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against Moz official pricing schedule.

claimProvenance.claim: SE Ranking Essential plan is $55/mo providing 750 daily tracked keywords, cloud site audits, and backlink monitoring.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against SE Ranking pricing calculator.

claimProvenance.claim: Comparative evaluation of SE Ranking, Moz Pro, Screaming Frog, and seoClarity across keyword quotas, audit depth, and pricing.
claimProvenance.notes: Corroborated across official vendor specifications.

claimProvenance.claim: Comparative evaluation of Make, n8n, Zapier, and Power Automate on operation costs, self-hosting options, and AI agent integration.
claimProvenance.notes: Corroborated across official vendor pricing and architecture docs.

claimProvenance.claim: Comparison of Kit (ConvertKit), Brevo, MailerLite, and Mailchimp based on subscriber allowances, send volumes, and automation.
claimProvenance.notes: Corroborated with live vendor pricing tiers.

claimProvenance.claim: Invoice Ninja alternatives analysis comparing Wave ($0 free), QuickBooks, Xero, and Akaunting for self-hosted and cloud billing.
claimProvenance.notes: Corroborated with open-source repositories and cloud pricing.

claimProvenance.claim: Wave offers $0 free base invoicing and double-entry bookkeeping with 2.9% + $0.60 credit card and 1% ACH processing fees.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against Wave official pricing and terms of service.

claimProvenance.claim: Invoice Ninja v5 AGPLv3 is free for self-hosting with 0% extra payment gateway markup; Cloud Pro is $12/month.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against Invoice Ninja GitHub repo and pricing schedule.

claimProvenance.claim: QuickBooks Online alternatives evaluation comparing Wave ($0), Invoice Ninja (self-hosted), and Xero ($15/mo) against Intuit tiered seat caps.
claimProvenance.notes: Corroborated against Intuit QuickBooks published pricing tiers.

claimProvenance.claim: seoClarity provides custom enterprise pricing ($750+/mo) with uncapped daily rank tracking on ClarityGrid and ClarityAutomate edge SEO.
claimProvenance.notes: Corroborated with seoClarity platform documentation.

claimProvenance.claim: SE Ranking alternatives analysis comparing Screaming Frog (£199/yr), AccuRanker ($129/mo), and Moz Pro ($99/mo).
claimProvenance.notes: Corroborated against SE Ranking and competitor docs.

claimProvenance.claim: Moz Pro alternatives analysis comparing SE Ranking ($55/mo daily tracking), Screaming Frog, and Semrush.
claimProvenance.notes: Corroborated against Moz Pro documentation.

claimProvenance.claim: AIOSEO alternatives analysis comparing Rank Math ($69.99/yr unlimited sites), SEOPress ($49/yr), and The SEO Framework.
claimProvenance.notes: Corroborated against WordPress plugin repositories and pricing.

claimProvenance.claim: Rank Math alternatives analysis comparing AIOSEO, SEOPress, Yoast SEO, and The SEO Framework for site speed and custom schema.
claimProvenance.notes: Corroborated against Rank Math official documentation.

claimProvenance.claim: AccuRanker alternatives analysis comparing dedicated rank tracking vs all-in-one SEO platforms (SE Ranking, Nightwatch, seoClarity).
claimProvenance.notes: Corroborated against AccuRanker official pricing.

claimProvenance.claim: Kùzu alternatives analysis comparing embedded graph database Kùzu (MIT C++) against Neo4j, Memgraph, and DuckDB.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against Kùzu official GitHub repository and documentation.

claimProvenance.claim: Headlamp alternatives analysis comparing open-source Headlamp (Apache 2.0) against Lens Desktop ($19.90/user/mo), k9s, and Portainer.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against Headlamp GitHub repository and Lens pricing.

claimProvenance.claim: Databox alternatives analysis comparing Databox data source caps against Looker Studio ($0 free), Metabase, and Geckoboard.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against Databox pricing calculator.

claimProvenance.claim: Head-to-head comparison of AWS and Google Cloud evaluating GKE vs EKS, BigQuery vs Redshift, and sustained use discounts.

claimProvenance.claim: Homarr alternatives analysis comparing drag-and-drop dashboard Homarr against Homepage (YAML declarative), Dashy, and Heimdall.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against Homarr and Homepage GitHub repositories.

claimProvenance.claim: Hetzner Cloud VPS starts at €3.79/mo (CAX11 Arm64) with 20TB included traffic per VM and dedicated server auctions from ~€35/mo.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against Hetzner Cloud official pricing schedule.

claimProvenance.notes: Verified against Security Onion documentation and GitHub repository.

claimProvenance.claim: Apache Guacamole alternatives analysis comparing clientless HTML5 gateway against Teleport, RustDesk, and Kasm Workspaces.
claimProvenance.notes: Verified against Apache Guacamole and Teleport documentation.

claimProvenance.claim: Vultr operates across 32 global datacenters with High Frequency compute from $6/mo, $0 control plane Kubernetes (VKE), and NVIDIA GPUs.

claimProvenance.claim: DataForSEO alternatives analysis comparing pay-as-you-go SERP APIs ($0.60-$2.00/1k calls) against SerpApi ($50/mo) and Bright Data.
